t:
Listen carefully.

During the Storm, the heroes we are opposing will not be able to resist their greed - they will go after the Ifrits' treasures.

The jinns are unhappy about it, so they will do everything they can to stop them. Alas, their power is not infinite.

So we... help each other. During the Storm, Ifrits will grant you special powers - you will turn into a mirage and will be able to strengthen their servants.

Ifrits will only be appeased if the servant you empowered joins a fight and dies - that's how the energy you transferred to it will return to the Ifrits.

You will get this kind of task daily.

Your mission is to complete my tasks. Preferably every day, but we'll see. I'll welcome any help. Call your friends if you like.

Remember - you'll be just a pioneer to everyone around you. A inconspicuous pioneer, one among many. Even the local monsters will pay no mind to you.

It will help you act covertly. Endow the Ifrits' servants with power, collect Ambrosia. With time, I might give you other tasks.

To many different places, youngling. Thousands of years ago, the first caravan set off from here, and now, centuries later, the ships of the desert are on a long journey once again.

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. There will always be caravans, camels loaded with bundles, and they will keep going forward, into the desert... Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And camels will always be here.

Many things, youngling. What was, and what will be.

Thousands of years have passed, and the wind still whispers. Countries change, cities change, but the desert remains the same. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the wind will always be here.

Many things, youngling. Things you and I have no idea about.

What was before, will happen again. New conquerors will come, but the little scarab will continue its work! Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the scarab will always be here.

The sun sees many things, youngling. It saw how the Great Mage was taken to the southern edge of the desert after a lost duel. It watched as he gathered armies, watched them set out for the north.

Many things have changed over the years, but the sun still rises over the desert. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the sun will always be here.

The cacti dream of many things, youngling. They slumbered when these lands belonged to the Zem people. They slumbered when the caravans of the Ugra people crossed the desert.

Everything comes and goes, but the cacti still bloom at the appropriate time. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the cacti will always be here.

The birds talk about many things, youngling. They warned each other when they saw a caravan move through the desert, they watched as Nezeb searched for the hidden jinn kingdom and discussed it among themselves.

The desert will always be here, and so will the birds. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the birds will always be here.

They seek many things, youngling. They prowled the land around the tents of the Ugra people, watched the fires from the darkness. They saw how the Great Nezeb fought for power, defeating one leader after another.

The laws of the desert are unforgiving, there is no mercy. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the animals will always be here.

Many things, youngling. The rocks were the ancient walls of the magical jinn kingdom where we hid from the troubles of this world. But they weren't enough to hide us from Nezeb's craving for power.

The rocks still stand, but the jinns were enslaved. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the rocks will always be here.

They guard many things, youngling. The jinn people are numerous, there are many tribes - and we swore to guard the Great Nezeb's treasures.

But not all of us are faithful to duty. Fire Ifrits want these treasures for themselves! Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the jinns will always be here.
My crabs are faster than everyone else! Lightning always comes first, then it's Thunder and Breeze, and then all the rest.
Careful with the rocket! No, you won't need a helmet, the water won't hurt you. Ready!

Do you want to race my crabs? I'm afraid this is not the right time. The wrong winds are blowing. They might take you away to the Astral, so no flying just yet. Look up the next event in your calendar!
Perish the thought, you can't fly in such a weather. What if the wind blows you out into the Astral? Look up the calendar first.
Well, here comes the terror of the depths!
No, not now, sorry. The Squawker is not ready to fly. Look up the event in your calendar.
They say, never shall those born to swim, learn to fly! Oh but yes we shall! I've been dreaming of flying since I was born, and now look, we've got our Squawker! Want a ride?
Do you want a ride? Such a pity, Squawker cannot fly right now. Look up the event in your calendar and come back.

It's not only birdies and butterflies that fly over the Atoll! We've raised a wonderful Squawker bird. He loves giving people rides!
He's not quite fully trained yet, but we're working on it. He's a great singer, too. When you ride him and hear him sing - encourage him, alright? No, not with treats - we feed him well enough, thank you. He loves fireworks! As soon as he starts singing - set off fireworks!
I'm sure you're going to love flying around. Just be careful not to fall off. Take a deep breath if your head starts spinning. Shut your eyes if the sun dazzles you. Cry if you feel like crying, shout if you feel like shouting! Enjoy the ride!

Wow! What a catch! Lucky you!

Here are your 100 Seashells, like I promised! If you find another, bring it here, too.

Sometimes special pearl oysters appear in the sea. You can find a very valuable Black Pearl inside. If you find one, bring it to me before it becomes faded!

I will reward you generously!

When catching flying bubbles, you may accidentally come across a durable inflatable bubble. If you find one in your bag, take it out and try to inflate it.

Inflate carefully! If you see that the bubble has turned red, stop blowing and let it cool down a little until it's no longer red, then inflate it further. Just pay attention - it deflates over time when you are not blowing.

If you can blow a bubble the size of my house, you'll get a nice prize. And don't be upset if your bubble bursts - you will still get a reward. The bigger the bubble, the greater the reward.

That's it!

It's easy!

This happens every June now. The breeze carries the sea foam to shore, blowing bubbles all over the beach. I don’t know why the bubbles come out so rainbow-colored, but it’s a real feast for the eyes!

Of course, there are people who love popping them. At first I chased them away, but then I thought - why not?

If you want to try it, I'll give you the Frog Amulet so that you can jump high and far. The rest is simple - you jump towards the bubbles and they - pop! - burst.

Pop a hundred, and I'll give you shells. And we also consider it a special achievement to burst a dozen in one jump or a hundred in a minute. So if you want to show your special skills in catching bubbles, now is the time. There will be no bubbles in July!
Just look how amazing they are! How beautifully they shimmer in the sun! And how loudly they burst!

The bubbles are so beautiful and so fragile - they have all burst!

Come back a little later - soon the wind will bring a pile of new bubbles from the sea. Here, take a look at the calendar!

In June, the wind brings beautiful iridescent bubbles from the sea. Their time is over now, but next year they will return again.

Come visit me next summer if you want to chase after them.
Usually Jack buys these pills from me. I will make a pill for you in exchange for 10 insects of any kind.

The third race of every hour is with random bets!

I'll roll the dice, and it will determine which crab your bet will land on. You can't change your bet, only wait until next time.

The risk is high, but the reward is also higher!

1st place - 25 shells,

2nd place - 20 shells,

3rd place - 15 shells,

4th place - 12 shells,

5th place - 10 shells,

6th place - 8 shells.
Fine. Go and pick your future pet.
Now go to the egg keeper and ask for an egg.

Excellent fruit, juicy and tasty!

What should I add? Some rum? Perhaps tequila?

Let me guess - the past few days weren't easy for him? It's not surprising - your pet exhausted himself and ate too much!

Bring me fat bugs and butterflies of all kinds, and I will prepare a special potion that will cheer the fledgling up.

Quarr! It is time, yes? You'll get your equipment!

But I've run out of certain materials. Bring them to me - I'll give you a discount.

Bring me two dozen palm leaves, one tough pearl oyster shell, and 90 seashells.

Usually I take a hundred, but like I said - I'm giving you a discount!

Good!

Once your parrot's training is complete, come back here. I should be done by then.

It's ready! Take it!

Hold on tight, fly freely, and keep your eyes peeled to the sky!

Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman. Then I'll give you another task to help you raise your parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you remember where the Wise Woman is? Her name is Willa.
How is your feathered friend? Give him regards from me and my tribe!
I have a new task for you.
That's all for today! Come back tomorrow to get your new tasks.

Once every few hours, I can suddenly announce a friendly race!

You will find out if I am going to organize a race as soon as my attraction opens. I will even give you a separate task for this!

If a race is planned, it will start five minutes before the end of my attraction, just like the sailboat races of the Aviaks.

You will need to start on my command together with all the other participants. And then just run as usual.

Come and get an additional reward!

As you wish, my dear friend!

How did I do that? Oh, it's a little secret of our tribe. Enjoy the darkness and the light of the bonfires!

First, you need a partner - can't play alone. Or better yet, four - the more players you have, the more points you earn. Hugi is always around, if there's no one else to play with.

You need to play in the court - and don't take the ball away from the court, or else it will leave you. Yes, it can do that.

To begin the game, you need to pick up the ball and serve it.

And then you need to run around and keep the ball from falling. And watch where you're sending the ball - turn to face the player you want to pass it to. Try to pick players who haven't hit the ball in a while. The more often everyone hits the ball, the more points you all get.

Try not to drop the ball. The longer the ball stays in the air, the more points everyone gets for hitting it.

For every ten hits, you get seashells. The more points you earn, the more seashells you get!
After running around after the ball for a bit, you should be able to beat monsters more easily. It will do you good!
We're playing beach volleyball here. But the court is temporarily closed. I'll rake the sand and clean the ball - then we'll be open again!

A lantern is another symbol of the sun. Like the sun, they float beyond the horizon, but the sun sinks into the sea, then emerges.

Keep the small suns - your lanterns - alive until they reach the end of their journey.

That's how this holiday is celebrated.

A nice wind, isn't it?

Want to go sailing?

The wind is too weak right now...

Come back later!

Only those who completed a training with Gik are allowed to join!

Once you're done, come back.
Come here, land dweller! I'll teach to you to soar like a bird!
Demons? What demons? As if the Leper was not enough! Where have the demons come from? Go talk to Ratmir, let him explain!
Let’s hope fish is hungry and likes the berries. You wouldn’t want it to snack on you, would you?
Let’s go into my chamber and talk.
Don’t hit me! I’m going to cry!
Avadhuta had a book! Colorful! With pictures! But the guards took it away and said bad words. Avadhuta is going to cut their heads off, nobody says bad words any more.
This is so wet, and gloomy, and smells bad! I’ll have to order to clean this room thoroughly... later.
I overestimated my abilities last time. Look out and destroy everything and everyone that approaches me this time!

Living gems, you say? You mean those I gave to druids as a thank you for healing my little brother?

You cannot find any more of these. I had a gold mine, that could give a gem or two once in a while, that’s true, but no such living gems never existed there.

They way I obtained the Prophetic Ruby, that living gem you’re asking of, was pretty weird. My people came to me in horror once, and asked me to go down the shaft.

I descended, alone, for noone wanted to keep me company - they all were too scared. I saw a crack in the wall, all in green smoke and light, and there was a tiny lizard on the stone. She spoke to me, saying she had a gift for me. Then she waved her tail and disappeared, leaving a pile of precious glittering gems.

I took them and left. What it was, I do not know. And the Ruby served me well, see?
I know all roads and paths. I listen to beasts and fishes, and trees, and mountains. Nobody knows what the source of the Leper is...
We couldn’t even think of sending the dreadful disease to our own land! We are trying to fight it, but our power is not enough. Faith is our power, and it is running out...
You are not the only one who calls upon us!

No human could do such harm. Whoever did this, I don’t know. There is great magic being done in the Astral. No godly magic, no Light, no dragon’s magic - it has come from another world! I don’t know whether it’s for the good or for the bad, either.

I can see how much you care about Umoir. Try and talk to Catherina. Make her stop following and persecuting the true believers, the old druids. She cannot stand alone. Tell her about the strange magic.
We will stand! This is our land! We must unite! We will never give up our lands!

I love the fight, but we’re not fighting the right thing. We don’t have to fight one another, trying to find out whose faith is better. The Leper must come first!

I’m even to ready to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Light, only to defeat the Leper.

What a curious thing! Let me take a closer look.

No, I can’t help you. You need to ask Emelian, he’s a great ship master. Well, he used to be, before he lost himself into drinking and was fired. He knows a lot, though. You will find him in Upper City - he’s easy to recognize, he is always drunk as hell.

Oh, Miloslavin, he’s in prison. Stole something, I guess. He’s lucky not to have been kicked out into the Astral. It’s all thanks to the Queen’s protection. It was her order to consider him a native Umoirian - ah, let it be then. Our punishment for theft is cutting off arms! No pity to thiefs.
Ouch, hole in your pouch! Here’s your precious gem, make sure not to lose it again!
Why are you pestering me again?
I’m not holding you here! Go, and don’t come back.
You can hear distant sounds of carriage wheels, steps, hooves, and feel the smell of campfire and herbs...
Oh, so you like my sword, eh? Let’s play then, my sword, your gold. If you win, take the sword. If I win, your gold is mine. What do we play? Heads or Tails.
See the coin? This side is heads, the other side is tails. I flip it, I snip it, I turn it around, what’s your guess?
Good guess, you lucky dastard! Here, take my sword, it’s no good for anything, anyways.
Good guess, you lucky dastard! Here, take my sword, it’s no good for anything, anyways.
Ha ha! Wrong! I’m so lucky lucky lucky today! Let’s play once again, huh?
Ha ha! Wrong! I’m so lucky lucky lucky today! Let’s play once again, huh?
Hey, do you have a coin? No? You’re down and out too? Go find one first, then we’ll play.
Ahoya, military man! What is that you want?

You’re devil, and your dark deeds and sins will drag you to the saddest of the sad places, you’ll see! Depriving poor people of their last copper coins! The gallow has long been missing Jade, can’t wait to hug his neck! You’ll see, he will drive you to hell, too!

Here. Tell him he’ll pay for his sins one day, oh yes, he will!

Who’s the fairest one of all? You are a great and fair Sarnaut hero, powerful and strong, worthy of everyone’s adoration - the League and the Empire, the high and low, the great mages and the crowd! Do you want to know your future? What awaits you? Look me in the eye! See your Destiny!

Don’t go! Are you scared to even look? I can only show you what’s inside your head, that is it. You cannot be afraid of your very self, can you?

Don’t be. Look at your dark side. Love it. Be it. This is your might. Follow Annette and Yaga to obtain your power in the depths!

Are you really leaving? Come back! Look at yourself! Ah, very well, go now. I know you will come back.
Things like that aren’t easily lost. Here it is. Kick her hard!
We are not so young and strong as we used to be...

The cold stone sounds like whisper: "Return what’s ours! We won’t forgive! We won’t let go, till you return what’s ours!" Judging by the holes in the stone, someone’s taken our the gems and insulted the Spirits of the Woods. Who could it possibly be?
The wisper fades, and the roots around the cave entrance step back with a howl.

Annette kept a journal of her miseries in this notebook. After her mother's death, her father married a noble Kanian woman of the Yagas family. The stepmother turned out to be a selfish, jealous and cruel woman. She abused Annette, mistreated her husband and depressed the whole House.

The notebook doesn't give us a clear notion of what has happened here: it misses half of its pages!

That’s a thing to thank for! We haven’t seen much of you after the Crystal Palace had fallen. The wise men say, before the grief comes, the city won’t know its hero! Look at me, I’m a simple blacksmith, not a leader. When we appeared in this frozen place, everyone went crazy. Some just stood there, others were running in circles and screaming... I had to take the leadership.

As long as there are only two of us, let’s sit down and think, how to get back home. Oh, before we do that, can you do us a favor, please? The damned monkeys stole our belongings and buried them down in the hollow. Please help us find our things! We're not that rich now to leave them scattered.
I am happy to see you again.
How can you do this! Helping erect the idol, summon the false god, talk to it! Return this dirty crocodile, where it belongs. I hope you are sorry about that.
You’re persistent, aren’t you? Catherina will know all about this.
This is hereticism! Just look at it, all green and blue, like the Leper. What good can it be?
I guess, you’re right, we have no other options. Okay, you may talk to him, but make sure to visit the church after we’ve returned!
See, I was right! You weren’t that wrong, eather. Let’s do it now.

Of course, of course, it’s high time! I think you need to lead the process, for you’re the only one who knows and brings the truth! Stand right there and give us orders! Be careful with the snow, it doesn’t seem to like being sculptured and always turns into aggressive monsters.
Why, sure! But those old beggars are still in doubt...

This was the first echo of the upcoming war. There were no enemies, no alliances, no armies, but the war was inevitable.

But you have another path to follow, so walk your way! Become strong. Keep your weapons ready. Look out. Protect, when the time comes.

It’s a simple question. They’re here, because I brought them here. You have no idea how much power the Tep’s Spark conceals - however, less than it used to! How tempting it is! I cannot entrust it neither to Aidenus, nor to Yasker or Zayan, not even Holy Zosim. It will remain here, heat the cold stone, help the trees grow and grant life to those, deprived of it by Tep.

Disgust and disgrace. It’s worse that the Plague or demons - they merely killed, that’s all. The Leper transforms, changes... corrupts! Corrupts in the way, presupposed by somebody.

It’s funny, you know. You don’t often ask me questions, and now that you do, I cannot give you a reply! I don’t know who started the Leper. I have no idea how to stop it. I can only keep it within the limits, though I’m far from saving Umoir... But I will! Some day I will!
I have many things to do, as well as you! Send my cheers to Catherina!

These monkeys are so sly and fast! While you chase one, it throws the orange to another one, and another! But your legs are longer, and there are two of you, so you will do better. Save as many oranges as you can. We won’t survive without them.

Oh bliss! Oh oranges! This smell and color, and juiciness! No gem will ever compare you you, oh orange! But I’m humbly asking you, hero, to accept this gold as reward. If you can save more oranges, bring them in! Every seed counts!
There were those who were afraid of Abordazh the Merciless. There were those who were afraid of the Red Beard. Feint himself was afraid of me!
In an hour those who’ll live will envy the dead!
I planted the charges, and the guys are ready for the assault. It’s all up to you now.
See that jumper over there? The only problem is that it seems to be locked. Let’s search this pile of rubbish, we might find the key.
Right. You look over there, I’ll look here.

It’s clear: we shall get them rid of the marks and put the poor things to rest. Let’s beat the pirates up, and as soon as they open their mouths, you grab the marks. We’ll throw the damned things into the Astral, out of harm’s way.
Once we’re here, why don’t we help the old man.
Look at that. That’s Feint’s style! The arrow is pointed at the next allod. That’s where we will move. If we’re lucky, we may even find your friend’s traces there. And maybe more.

Look at them, they won’t disappear, however hard you beat them. Do you know who they are? Feint’s crew. He wasn’t a mage, but he knew the legends well enough. They say, if you put a black mark into a dead sailor’s mouth, he won’t rest in peace, until he gets rid of it. Let’s help them, shall we? I’m sure they will be grateful.

Look who’s here! Good old Merry! Why are you so sad today? Where’s the smile? Ahha, there it is, lovely, as ever, only a bit too far from the rest of your body. Not so funny to have your skull played as a foot ball, eh?
Calm down?! Do you have any idea how many of them were there? Who took it? Who? Oh, right. I know. Let’s beat them up and see if any of them remembers how to speak. Are you with me?
There is a way. Can you see the dark shadows? They can pass through this veil easily. Let’s collect some cinder from them and rub it in our bodies, then the veil won’t stop us.

Here’s their junk. And their tracks - they go to the forest, and so clearly visible, we can find them without a hound dog. Aren’t you scared? It’s not too late to leave! No? Alright, let’s go then, and don’t forget - the gold is mine!
What? How? Where? Where’s the treasure? Where’s gold? Who took it all? I’ll be damned!
So, Benny came here first! It means, we can come through as well!
It’s Benny, Benny, poor Benny. Everyone has lost their minds, but Benny lost his body, now he’s with the shadows... he’s taken it there, there, all there, poor Benny...
What? It must be old dead Feint, he came for his treasure. No worries, it’s just another dead man.
Treasure! All mine! Mine! Ah-ha-ha! Everyone died! Silberpod has survived, alone! Alive! And rich!
A dead man doesn’t really need a horse.

Come again, what exactly do you want? My Roanie?! Would you also like a key to my tower, where I keep my jewels, huh?

Alright, alright! You can have it. I’ll give it to you, as soon as you will have performed my three tasks.
I owe some money to our gardener, Zakhar Curoed. Go to him and work it off.
Good day! What are you looking for?
Now you’re talking, we always need a hand here. Take the forage, feed the hens - they’re always pecking at my feet, I hate it.
Not bad, not bad at all. I’m too old to lift heavy bags and cut the hay... Now to your second task...
There are some lazy bones! They don’t plough, don’t plant, just wander around. The Empire, they say, sends them to exile. We’re not so cruel, so just teach them a little lesson, beat them hard!
Wohoa, look at that, how they rush into the field!
It’s the most difficult one... Listen.
Thank you! Milava, come up... What are you looking at? Leave us alone now!
Keep dreaming! Take the broom, it’ll do for the horse!
That was fast. Thank you. Tell Mira, we’re even.
Good day! Can I help you?
Bird’s feathers are shining with the living flame.
It seems that the bird is happy to leave this forest.
I’ve got the horse, right? It means that the harness is mine, too, and the briddle, and the saddle, and the girl!
If you won’t give her the easy way, I’ll give you the hard way!
Oh, hello! Look, brother, it’s Firebird! Like I told you, and you didn’t believe me!
Greetings to you too, friend. Enough with the jokes, give us the bird. We’ll take it to Catherina ourselves. Seeing the Queen is too much honor to you, vagabond.
Holy Tensess, I come for thee...

There ain't nothing difficult in handling these idiots. Just shout loud enough and make sure to pop your eyes out to make them fear you!

Remember the commands: "Move it", "Wrong way" and "Freeze". They don't get it any other way, believe me.

If any of them dies, there ain't no big deal. Just don't let the bomb explode, or we're all dead.
If anything goes wrong, I didn't see you!
Soul... Where is my soul?! Have you seen it?

Eyes! They stare, and stare, and then the light. And my soul - phew! My soul's gone! Hahaha! Looking for the soul, hahaha! The soul's gone, HE took it. HE sees everything! Where there was lighthouse, now HE is!

Time! Time heals, heals the souls. When time isn't flowing, the soul isn't living. Ahaha! Sparks are scattered around, oh...

HE! HE is looking! And seeing everything!
What? The Alliance? I don't know anything about any Alliance! I want my Yegor back! Where is here? Are the monsters gone?

Get away! Don't touch me, you demon! Your words won't confuse me!

May the Light save us...
You say the harbor is safe? As if I would believe it! The monsters are coming from there. I will hide here until the reinforcement from the Iron City arrives!
None of this would have happened in Nezebgrad...

Stop! Who goes there?

Are you from the Iron City?
Alright, we don't have time for chatting. Take you sword and slay the bastards! We can talk afterwards...
Here you go... Just don't let the guards see you!

Ah... It wasn't my idea, I swear! It was that human. I met him near the monolith on the bottom of the lake. Nobody knew what was that stone and where it came from, but he knew! He told us about the strangers from the sky, who sent us the great gift that would lead our people to glory!

It was then that I understood that the Great Fish never answered us because it didn't exist. And the monolith is real, I can feel its power right now!

Stupid Hariuses never believed me! All they want is to live on humans' charity, but we, together with the monolith and the strangers from the sky, can become the masters of the lakes and the rivers! All we have to do is to pray and bring gifts to the monolith. Hariuses didn't like that, but our people have made the choice! Now I am the lord, and Hariuses are pitiful outcasts!

When strangers from the sky will endow me with power, the whole world will kneel before me! Ah... Did I say it out loud?

To arms, my faithful warriors! Defend your Great Prophet! Warriors? Where are you?..

Don't touch me!
Aho! It seems to be quiet here, but stay alert - the Architects may be anywhere.

It's Antonis! He makes us do that. The Guards of the Order gave him a great power. He says he will use it drive all humans away from the lake shores!

When Julis tried to contradict, Antonis almost killed him. It sparked off a real rebellion! Prince Janis fled with his wounded father, and I wanted to leave with them - but I was too scared. Let me go, please! I don't want to fight.

Ay me, they are talking about the traitors even on the shore!

So here is what happened. Antonis, the first priest of the Great Fish, betrayed us. He has gone insane! He says, the strangers from the sky are the real gods, the Guards of the Order. He says, they came from the sky to punish the humans who encroach upon our lake. What a guff! Humans have never been our enemies.

The Architects? Is this how you call the strangers from the sky?

My father became suspicious at once. But he was too old. Antonis yelled that the stone in the middle of the lake is a sign from the above, a sign of the new age of freedom! Phew! But he was very convincing. I tried to bring other Nyxes to their senses, but nobody listened to me. Me and my father had to flee as cowardly shrimps!
Why do you need to go to the Iron City? Are you lying to me, human? No? Then prove it!
What are you doing? This is our lake!
Why are you staring at me?
What? I have no idea what you are talking about!
You know what? Go to... Rohlin. He's been talking about... that sort of things.
What do you want? Come on, spit it out.

Damn it, why don't you mind your business? You think I didn't know it was Syoma? He is a chatterbox and nothing more, but who stands behind him? Who gave him the leaflets, do you know? Neither do I! I was watching him, hoping to get at something, and now you've ruined everything!

Get lost. No use of you here!
The altar is covered with blood and writings in blood, and the bodies of the sacrificed citizens lie beside it.

They are written in blood. Something about "the Prophet", "the Ascension", "Perfection through Eternal Order", and "parts of the whole". The madmen that wrote it seemed to be truly believing that the Architects were gods. And that they can make people equal gods...

What a heresy. What made those misfortunates believe in such thing? How can be good intentions covered in blood?!
Greetings! How can I help you?
Hell if I know! They just jump out from under the ground.
Let me think... You know what - they swarm near the shell craters. Maybe you should take a closer look at them?
I have no idea. You know, I noticed that some of the shells do not explode when they hit the ground - and then the Architects appear next to the craters.
They want war? We will give them war!

First, the Portals stopped working. Then, Adventurer's Stones started behaving unpredictably. But we only realized that was not a coincidence after the White Fortress was attacked...

Unfortunately, we don't have a Great Mage here on Dane, who could have transmitted the message throughout Sarnaut, so we had to face the invasion on our own. The capital is blocked, the northern part is flooded with the Architects, and I have no idea what is going on in the east and in the Iron mountains.

What can we do against that giant thing?! Do you have a cannon in your pocket by any chance? No? Well neither do we!

Listen, can you sneak to Full Moon and see if and of its cannons are still working? It would help us greatly!
Ah... They are coming from the north!
An army! A whole army of the Architects! And a giant monster unlike any we've seen before. What do we do?!
O, hello! You marvel at the beauty of Full Moon, too? Indeed it's a splendid ship with a professional crew. We will give some hell to those Architects!
Have you lost your mind? Do you know what kind of training we have on Umoir? You won't figure out those levers in a year!
Get back! Get back, it's a trap!
I can't breathe! A grey veil in front of my eyes... I can't think... Every sound is as loud as thunder! It hurts!
Blue water! There, near the pier... Blue like blood!
Sorcery! Old human sorcery! They poison the water, poison our minds... We are fishers, not warriors... But we feel so much anger!
Where did I leave the waterdye seeds?..

Hey, what do you think you're doing?

You tryin' to intimidate me? You gonna turn me in to Ivan?

Eeh, alright, alright, I will tell you everything.

Hoof ordered us to get rid of someone without making a fuss. Who am I to contradict him? An order is an order!

Why did we have to kill you - I don't know. Gora Sharashkin brought us the paper with Hoof's signature from the refugees camp. It said that we had to take the Alliance spy for a ride, and that's it.

What do you want with me? Go and find Gora if you don't believe me!
The handle is polished to a luster after years of exploitation. A faintly visible hallmark is imprinted on the blade - two crossed pickaxes.

A regular axe for cutting logs - there are plenty of these in the camp. But the way the blows were dealt gives away a hand of a professional. There is a small chance that Gora will resurrect after this...

There are several crumpled papers on the bottom of the bag. These are the same leaflets that Syoma Rohlin had! The one that Hoof killed right in front of your eyes. So Hoof has something to do with the idiots who are trying to give in to the Architects?

It becomes more and more twisted...
The bag is full with all sorts of things. Looks like Gora was stealing everything he could lay his hand on.

Shoish! I know that hallmark!

Before my house was destroyed by the monsters from the void, I used to hunt and sell fresh game in the mines of the Iron City. There were crossed pickaxes on every instrument the miners used. Instruments like these cannot be sold or won. It means this axe belonged to a miner...
Greetings! What do you want to talk about?
Who are you? What do you want?
What do you mean, swish? The mine is closed! You better go away.
What are you talking about? Go to the city and buy there everything you need! They have all sorts of swishes.
I told you to get lost! You had your chance, now you're coming with us!

It all started with the "inspection". That dreadful minotaur, Hoof, with several suspicious individuals came shouting about the terrible conditions on the mine, and then declared it closed by the order of the Tycoon.

Well, I'm not only a geodesist, but a magician also, so I instantly saw that the order was fake. So I spoke up. Then the mess started...

It was a planned revolt! Part of the workers have already took the side of Hoof and his gang. They grabbed everyone who opposed them, slayed the director and captured all gold and meteo... Oh my! This is classified.
Oh... You... Ivan sent you? It is a nightmare! I thought we were all dead...

Architects? Never heard of them. But I can see you are telling the truth...

So you found a passage that led beyond Sarnaut on Ferris? You stirred up a wasps' nest, and now the wasps strive for revenge? Interesting, interesting...

As far as I understand, Architects are not actually gods. They are not creators but something else. Modifiers? Probably. They can modify space as well as time...

So, what do we have here?

Huh! The new play with the old actors.

May I ask, what you are doing here?

Return to Umoir? No way. I won't have anything to do with that drama queen again.

Though... Ah, taking the helm of Eclipse is worth putting up with the temper of its owner.

Damn those rotten rats! I haven't drunk a single drop of water in the last three days.

You are right in time, friend. They were about to start shredding my skin...

Why? For no reason. If there were a reason, they would have killed me right away. Just some old grudge...

This man is not lying, believe me. If everything is really that serious, and the Architects are ready to launch a full-scale invasion, we need to act right now! I will contact my command immediately and demand putting all our military divisions on full combat alert.
Good day, comrade! How can I help you?

If that honorable smuggler is not lying, it means that a great war lies ahead of us. And when it's upon us, there will be no time for diplomacy. I don't think something really depends on me now. I will send a message our command to urge them to put their troops on full combat alert. My mission here is over.
Greetings! I believe we have not before.
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!

Egh, come on! We have nothing to do with that. Haven't you heard of the Mercenaries' code, eh? We are the Free Traders' guards, and we are just executing their orders.

They told us to beat you up. So go and sort this out with them. This is none of our business!
Hey you! You got problem, fella?
The space around the Distortion melts and shifts.
Aagh! What is this mist? We're being poisoned...
What are you talking about! We are already dead...
Great! So we've been waiting for you? Listen then...

This neighborhood is quite troubled - we get knife fights every week, but this is something we couldn't expect.

Look, the body is neatly dismembered, and some of the organs are missing. I may be wrong, but it seems to me that all life energy was drained of the body before it was actually dismembered. It could be a skillful mage, but mages usually don't leave gigantic footprints. This means...
There's... There's a monster! We found it!

We found the killers! They were hiding in the basement near the abandoned garden. There was an ugly creature with them - in the dark, I couldn't tell if it was human or an Architect. It tore the guards to pieces and ran to the eastern gates, and the rest of them followed it. We need to go there, now!

This wasn't a man! I swear, it wasn't.

I didn't really see anything - I just heard some noise and looked out of the window. It was very dark, and I only saw a shadow - a huge scary shadow! It had one arm longer than the other. And then I heard a terrifying scream. I hid under the bench and stayed there until the guards arrived...
I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like this.

Well, they called for our patrol squad right after the murder. I was the first one to arrive on the spot. The Elf's body was utterly disfigured - no head, no arms, chest cut open... They seem to have torn him apart really quick - there wasn't even much blood. There were also footprints near the body - they looked human, however, I've never seen such a huge man in my life! Why did they kill the poor guy and why did they need his body parts - I have no idea.

I didn't see their faces... They were wearing masks and floor-length robes. I couldn't take a proper look at the creature - it knocked me down as it rushed by me. It was huge as a troll... and it was whistling!

They ran that way, away from the city. Those two were carrying some bags - I guess they couldn't get too far.
Ask what you want, and then get off my back.

Godrick - this was the poor fella's name - liked to wet his whistle too much for an elf. So we decided to have a couple of beers together, and it was already past midnight when he left. As soon as I closed the gates, I heard something heavy falling on the ground. Then I heard voices above on the wall. I tried to look out of the window, but it was already too dark. While I was lighting a chip, I heard a terrible scream. And a whistle! A voice from above cried something, the whistle stopped, and then again there was a loud rumble somewhere above the roof, and then all went quiet. I walked outside, and - you know what I saw...
So, what's the news? Did you find the killer?

What a monster... How did it get inside the city unnoticed? I will give the guards a dressing down for such negligence! And you should bring these remains to Eladia - maybe she will figure out what kind of creature that was.
Hey, what's your detachment? A secret Alliance operation is taking place here! I order you to leave the territory, or we will have to use force!
What?! We warned you - guys, let's get that rat now!

Wait! Wait! I will tell you everything!

The Prophet! The Prophet told us to come here from the valley. He said that before our soul Transcends, we need to Ascend our bodies. For that, we needed some parts of those who used to be so close to the Perfectness! Everyone who wants to become an Initiate, needs to obtain those parts with their own hands. I swear we mean no harm! You just don't understand... The Order is the future! The future of whole Sarnaut! You all are servants of Chaos, and you will just keep on bringing more and more wars and destruction to our world!

Why don't you understand that?!
The old Portal seems to be functioning...
The cleft in the pattern looks like a keyhole.

Ah, my head hurts so much... Let me concentrate.

So they teleported behind the wall. Then they walked - quite a bit. And in the end I saw mountains, somewhere in the north-east - not far from the Astral shore - and Portal ruins. So this is how they get here! They couldn't cross the mountains, so they found an old June Portal and repaired it somehow!

Well, my eyes could have failed me - making prophecies is hard; it's like looking into murky waters. You should go and see for yourself if I was right. Maybe they took our sorceress somewhere through that Portal...

Is it so? Ah, I don't like looking into the past - makes my head hurt too much!

Wait, let me concentrate...

...

I can see! Some people... And something big... and evil... There are charms on it, so I can't see it clearly, but I can feel its aura... They are screaming... Eladia looks back... Flash of light - three of them fall down... Oh god... They killed Eladia!

...

Ah, no... She's alive. But I can't see her Thread... What is this? A Portal? They carry her by the arms... And they're carrying what's left of the monster....

...

I can't do this anymore!

The Path is not completed. The Universe is imperfect. Unpredictable. Chaotic.

I am the Order! I am the Architect, and I am the Path that leads to the Absolute. You cannot resist your predestination. Nothing can stop the Path!

Your mind is poisoned with Chaos. It is weak. It is shattered.

You don't understand. The Path has not been laid yet. The Path is the Purpose. The Purpose is the Meaning. You cannot stop what has been predestined!

When I lay the Path into your Chaos-stricken world, you will perceive it. You will become a part of the Whole. This is your destiny!

Chaos has not devoured your world completely. You understand!

Hold on! Stop destroying the parts of the Whole - it makes laying the Path harder. Wait until Fractal appears in your world. Accept the Ascension! This is the only way to meet your predestination and bring closer the fulfillment of the Design!
Finally! I thought no one would come to help us!

We are a partisan squad.

We hid in the forest after the monsters captured the White Fortress. Sidor, a Demon Hunter, was our chief. He sent us scouting.

And now there's a huge unit of Architects approaching our camp!

Me and the Priden girl want to distract them and lead them away from the camp. Can you help us?

Happy to hear that!

The plan is: we lure the monsters away from the camp - there where they cannot use their quantitative superiority, and then throw bombs on them. We have a whole crate of bombs!

There they are! The Architects!

You see the largest one? He is the commander. Without a commander, the rest of the Architects become somewhat dumb. Just like our army, huh.

You take the giant one. Distract him, while we lure the rest of them to the quarry. Meet us there!
Come on, we will cover you!
We spotted a big group of Architects. If they reach the camp, we're done. So we need to draw a red herring across their path. We will lure them into the old quarry and then rain bombs on them.
Tonight the Victory Banner will stream above this citadel!
So only you can defeat this huge thing that can stop time? If you say so... We will try to keep away from it.
Go ahead! We will cover you back!

How do you know? Do you see the future? What if you're wrong?

Alright, I will do as you say.
Neither do I. The next question is: who is Tep?

And also a maniac and a pervert.

Alright, answer this: who is Tensess?

Correct! I'm glad you can see the difference between the reality and the teachings of the church.

And the next one: why does the Astral absorb all matters?

Well, I wouldn't argue with that.

Here's the last one. Finish this sentence: don't trouble trouble until...?

Don't you have a little sense of humor?

Well, what can I say. If you are willing to survive, there's nothing I can do!

Here, drink this mixture and go away.
Clearly, you haven't recovered yet. I need you to stay in the hospital.

Let's assume it is, so what?

You are clearly unable to link up a logical chain and need further treatment.
That's some risky talk! I can't let you out when you're like that. They will blame me for releasing a psychopath!

Is he a god? Really? As far as I remember, you participated in the events on Asee-Teph and communicated directly with his Spark.

You are still obviously suffering from memory lapses and need further treatment.
No need to get so excited! This is all for your own good. Have another week in bed...
Buy from me and no one else!

Spare me! I swear I didn't know these were stolen!

A man brings me goods every other day. He was going to come today and take his part of the proceeds. Wait for him! I have nothing to do with that.

It's not me! They forced me!

I am just a warehouse clerk. The bandits told me they'd embowel me if I refused to help them. I had no choice!

Please, let me go!
Go away... Go away! You don't exist!
The space around the Distortion flows and trembles. Some vague images emerge and disappear in it.

Something's wrong. You don't feel the same pull that you felt next to other Distortions. Something's missing. You should speak to Unn to find out how this Distortion is different from the previous ones.
The space is shivering, as if being crumpled by an un overwhelming force!
I remember you - we met in the Shore City! I am Bjorn the Seagull, the captain of this unfortunate ship, and I am going to leave this place as soon as possible. Are you coming with us?
Run, of course. We have emptied the local military warehouse, so now our cargo hold bulges at the seams. I hope we don't turn over...

It is, but can you see those two dots in the sky? Those are Furies, flying Architects. As soon as we launch the reactor, they will riddle our hull, and we have no cannons to fight back. Somebody's going to have to distract them, and my bet it is going to be you!
Great! When the reactor heats up to the right temperature, I will let you know.
The only way to reach the shipyard lies through the city. It is swarming with the Architects, but we don't have other options.
The fleet is destroyed, the monsters are everywhere! We're doomed!
Thanks Tensess! We are saved! Cover me while I'm trying to reach the shipyard.

It's a miracle you survived after what Savant did to you. He tried to reverse the processes in your organism! Not just for a couple of years back, but more like a couple of centuries!

He attempted to destroy not just your body, but your whole being. If it hadn't been for me, your Spark would have completely disappeared from existence!

I warned you! You better listen to me next time.
Look who's here. How are you feeling? By the way, I was the one who carried you from the battlefield on my back!
Step by step, we are going ahead!

This is just what we need! Hold on a second...

Here you go. Just attach this ladder to the edge of the bridge!
The stone is cold and grim. The names of girls, who fell in battle with evil, can be immortalized on its flat side.

The cold stone reads:

Yela Komelkova

Rita Osanina

Lisa Brichkina

Galia Chetvertakova

Sonya Gurvichskaya

In loving memory of those who gave their lives for their motherland.

The Sculptor? I haven't heard of him. So the Architect is not integral? Or a part of him detached itself and gained its own will? This explains so much!

Like those fanatics who worshipped the Architect. I never believed that the Architects could have come up with the idea of their own cult and demand blood sacrifice! Why would they need Hoof or helpless Nyxes? But if the Sculptor had gained his identity after keeping company with the people from the Empire, then I am almost certain that all that plotting was his doing!
Here the Threads intertwine in a strange Pattern...
Oh... Who are you? Where is my husband?

So... We cannot even resurrect now. What will poor Yevsey do without us?

This was all because of a doll! I knew I shouldn't have let my daughter play with it. But she just loved it so much...

Tell Yevsey that everything is going to be fine. He is strong. And I... have to go now.

Hurr... Pff...

Hurr... Hey! What do you want?
I am a free goblin! I will do what I want!
Come on, I was just kidding!
I am such an idiot! Why didn't I take at least a stick or something to beat off the animals!
Wingless stranger! So that was you who my brave yet dumb son spoke about?

Yes, I know. I am against war. Cual is young, brave, and stupid. He found weapon. He wants to fight. He wants war... He is crazy!

Bandits come and go, but the winged people stay. However, I did not say no. If he wants to fight, he may. Maybe a punch in the head will teach him something? Just make sure they don't kill him.
What do you want? Speak and get lost.
You're a slick one, ain't you?
Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?
Can you even fly it? Breeze is a rogue bird!

Well, since my plan was disrupted thanks to your courage, now go back and wait for me there. I can't stand flying, so I will make it on my own. Get out of here before the fanatics realized they are being attacked by an army and not by a single amateur bomber!
Ahem... What are you doing here?

Alright... This was as brave of you as it was dumb. You really think these clowns could have hurt me? Me? The one who saw civilizations rise and fall? Don't be so surprised, haven't you heard of Incarnations? Alright, let's talk about this later...

You see, I was playing helpless victim quite consciously and convincingly to find out who stands behind all this. It couldn't be a crazy goblin or a dumb minotaur.

This king of the Free Traders, he built himself quite a palace! More of a museum, actually.

Did you know Ivan Chelezny is an acknowledged collector? He lays his hands on all sorts of pieces of art, from silicon axes to elven statues, and the biggest part of his collection is stored in his country residence.

Now that place is occupied by the fanatics, so the museum is slowly turning into either a brothel or a nuthouse.

What about him? He's just a greedy boor who can sell his own mother for a handful of gold. However, he is packed into an Assault Shell and carries a Meteorite hammer, but anyway, I don't think he's a problem for you. He's not Tep after all, and definitely not my father... But he will fight for his gold till his last drop of blood, I can tell you that for sure.

If you defeat the Prophet and Hoof soon enough, bandits and fanatics will be beheaded and scattered. Then no one will stand in the way between us and the Sculptor.

The Prophet... I wonder where that crazy goblin came from. And also, how can people be such idiots?

Who in their right mind can believe a goblin on stilts, who wears a painted robe and carries a dead Architect core under his arm? This is pure madness. Maybe this is his secret? If one combines pure madness with infinite faith, it can become a terrifying weapon in the hands of a skillful puppet master, namely the Sculptor.

By the way, I heard there was a fire in a slum hospice right after the first Architects' attack on the Iron City. It was burned to the ground together with its patients and the staff, which usually consists of goblins. Some of the bodies were not found. Maybe this twisted faith in the "holy Architects" was born in that fire?

You mean those in the park? I don't like them either. It's so weird to see elves without wings!

I read about those statues in a popular scientific magazine, "Science & Death", in the Supernatural section. The Historians have discovered elven ruins on a distant allod which date back thousands of years. The destroyed city was built by elves before the Change - which means, long before the Cataclysm.

Just imagine how excited the archeologists were - the five elven statues remained intact among the ruins and ash! Too bad the ancient elves didn't like uninvited guests, so the second expedition found only withered remains of the first one at the feet of the statues. The second expedition was found dead on a plundered Astral ship... In its turn, the wrecked ship was discovered on a shore on Suslanger, and then the statues emerged on the black market after a while. Eventually, an anonymous collector bought them.

Some say the statues are cursed, some say that they still preserve ancient elven magic or even the Sparks of the heroes of the past... It seems that you will be the one to unearth the truth.
Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?

I knew there was someone more powerful behind the fanatics and the Prophet. At first I thought it could be a Great Mage, but when I heard them mention the Sculptor - and nobody told me about him for some reason! - everything became clear. However, I can only speculate about the purpose of their experiments. And my speculations are not comforting at all.

As you can remember, faith is a great power which can literally move mountains. The Architects - or should I say the Architect - is using the power of self-assertion. He believes in himself, and he is unflinching in his faith in the special purpose of his mind. But the Sculptor has lost that power when he detached himself from the whole. Now he is trying to compensate it by creating monsters who look like him and have infinite faith in his strength.
The first reasonable idea for today!
Well, let's go! We barely have anything to lose...
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
The door opens with a squeak.
Dents and burned stains on the door show that someone tried to break through it. Or keep restrained what's behind it...
The door is code-locked. Maybe you will find the password among the papers on the floor?

"The vocabulary of the Golem requires modification. Analyzing the logical component...

Stage two confirmed.

Stage three: injuring humans".

"Identification complete: Combat Golem Destroyer, category HK.

Access permitted.

Serious structure malfunction detected. Full diagnostics is recommended".

"Identification complete: Combat Golem Destroyer, category HK.

Access permitted.

Serious structure malfunction detected. Full diagnostics is recommended".
The massive stone gates slide into the hidden slots in the wall.

The key starts to glow dimly in your hands; you can hear rattling and humming behind the gates, then from under the ground a cold mechanical voice says: "No response received. Golem identification initiated."

"Damage detected in the Combat Golem structure. Automatic identification failed. Initiating mental activity identification.

Stage one: analyzing the accordance of the security rules."

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

"Stage one confirmed.

Stage two: following human commands."

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

You're asking for too much, don't you think so?

Alright, for this time, I will give you what you want. Let me see what I have.
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Where is the old one? Have you lost it? How irresponsible!
Close your eyes if you don't want to lose your mind.

You see... That was me who showed the Architect the way to Sarnaut! I didn't mean to, of course.

After what happened on Umoir, I was looking for a way to stop Sarn before he turned the world into dust, but I failed time after time until I remembered about the Star Gates. To bring my dad back to life, trap him, and make him do what I want - it all seemed so simple...

I reached the Gates and sent an electromagnetic impulse beyond the limits of our world, and I received an answer... I thought it was my father, so I just waited. But it turned out that my improvised beacon showed the Architects the way through time and space... I only realized it recently!

I know it sounds crazy, but believe me, we have no other options. Neither the League not the Empire have the power to stop a demiurge. A god can be only defeated by another god!

I'm telling the truth. What's the point of lying when my own life is at stake?!

Well, my plan was partly successful - I've brought a power that is able to defeat Sarn to this world. There is still hope! Chaos can only be stopped by Order. Sarn and the Architect are like positive and negative charges. If we manage to bring them together, they will eliminate each other, and even if one of them survives, he will be weakened, so we will handle him somehow.
Close your eyes and don't breathe!

This would be a dead frost. The elevator to Tep's chambers is broken, and the corridor to Nihil's chamber is occupied by the cultists and the Mechanoids. Sihal's laboratory is inaccessible as well. I'm not going to discourage you, but I can't risk my men's lives.

If you want my advise, you should capture one of the cultists alive and interrogate them. All sorts of surprises can be waiting for you inside!

Our lord will return! And when he does, you will shiver in agony and eat your rotting insides! No spells will help you - the Spear of Vengeance, created by Sihal from the shards of the divine weapon, will leave you no chance to survive!

Damn it! The cultists must have somehow carried their treasure away from the lab. Where do we look for the key now?

Alright, let's go back. It's too dangerous here.
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Too late! Even if I die, I will be reborn in the rays of glory! Hahaha!

Pathetic worms... The damned witch stole my power, so what? Did you achieve anything great, anything worthy or outstanding? Something that would be remembered through the centuries, something that would immortalize your names? You are nothing, just dust and ashes under the feet of the one who has embraced the Creator's design. The likes of you tried to master just one facet of the divine ability, but instead they have awoken powers unattainable for feeble worms!

If it had not been for damned Jeeg, I would have already laid my hands on the second Shard and released the world from the parasites who suck on its blood! I could have made it perfect!

You have made a mistake, worms. You cannot catch me unawares anymore! You cannot steal my Spark!

I will die - and I will return. I always return! I've been dying for thousands of years, and I have seen all faces of death! Miserable mortals... Your time will come.
Have you come to laugh at me, you worms? Go on then! Laugh while you still can!

Among all caves on Frontier, I would suspect the one that is being so persistently obstructed by the brave Watchful family. And since the Wormfaces are equally persistent in their attempts to clear it, I am pretty sure that the temple you are looking for is located there.

Let me think. Destroyers only dwell on this allod, which means their temple must be somewhere on Frontier. We haven't seen anything looking like a temple, which means it is hidden somehow. Most likely, under the ground. How do we get under the ground? Through a cave, obviously!
Ah, this so creepy. Tep's dead, but his Pyramid lives on with its own life. We need to get away from here as soon as possible!

Nothing has changed here... If the weapon does exist, it is not here.

I'm afraid we'll have to resort to extreme measures. There's no other choice. I will try to revive Tep's memory! I will instill a Spark into his withered remains and make him talk!

You think it won't work? Ha! Don't worry, I've almost depleted his Spark, so he won't be a threat... I'm almost certain. We won't know unless we try!

Well, let's try and resurrect the most dangerous and crazy sorcerer in the world! I always wanted to do something like this...
The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.
The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.

It’s easy for Yasker - they will just do whatever he says. And in the League... Oh, reaching any sort of concordance in the League is a pain in the neck.

But as I’ve said it many times... we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!

It’s easy for Yasker - they will just do whatever he says. And in the League... Oh, reaching any sort of concordance in the League is a pain in the neck.

But as I’ve said it many times... we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!
